tweets.text:
Surprised I'm not seeing more on the timeline about this.

One of the things $SUI is doing incredibly well is making stablecoin usage as frictionless of an experience as possible across its network.

Free p2p stablecoin transfers were implemented earlier this year, and now stablecoin for network fees on swaps natively in Slush.

If you've ever tried doing any dev work with agents, they all tend to prefer using cash.

Honestly though agents think the same as the majority of normies who don't know much about crypto... they're used to just paying cash and paying fees with cash and it takes a bit for them to understand why they need some other currency to do something else on the chain.

The less friction you have regarding using cash for any type of txs, the easier it makes growth.
